# SEO Foundation Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add a complete SEO meta-tag stack (description, keywords, canonical, hreflang, Open Graph, Twitter card), `robots.txt`, and an auto-generated `sitemap.xml` to `brigitte-le-roux.com` so search engines correctly index the bilingual site and surface rich link previews.

**Architecture:** All meta tags are emitted by `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro`, which now reads new optional props (`description`, `keywords`) and falls back to per-locale defaults stored in `content/i18n/{fr,en}.json` under a `site` block. `hreflang` alternates are computed from the page's logical slug via the same `import.meta.glob` lookup pattern already used in `LanguagePicker.astro`. The sitemap is produced by the official `@astrojs/sitemap` integration with its `i18n` option enabled, and `robots.txt` is generated by a static Astro endpoint at `src/pages/robots.txt.js` (so the sitemap URL stays derived from `astro.config.mjs`'s `site` setting).

**Tech Stack:** Astro 5, `@astrojs/sitemap` (new strict-pinned dep), Yarn, AWS (S3 + CloudFront — same deploy pipeline as before).

---

## File Structure

### New files

- `src/pages/robots.txt.js` — Astro endpoint that emits `dist/robots.txt`.
- `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-17-seo-foundation.md` — this plan.

### Modified files

- `astro.config.mjs` — register `sitemap()` integration.
- `package.json` + `yarn.lock` — add `@astrojs/sitemap` (strict-pinned).
- `src/content/config.mjs` — add `keywords: z.string().optional()` to the page schema.
- `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro` — major rewrite to emit the full meta-tag stack.
- `src/layouts/PageLayout.astro` — accept and forward `description` + `keywords` props.
- `src/pages/[...slug].astro` — pass `entry.data.description` and `entry.data.keywords` to `PageLayout`.
- `src/pages/en/[...slug].astro` — same.
- `content/i18n/fr.json` — add `site.description` and `site.keywords` keys.
- `content/i18n/en.json` — same.
- `CLAUDE.md` — short SEO subsection documenting the frontmatter fields and i18n fallback keys.

### Files NOT touched

- `public/` — robots.txt and sitemap are generated at build time, not stored statically.
- `scripts/*.sh` — `check-links.sh` and `pull-public.sh` remain as-is.
- `infrastructure/*.tf` — no AWS-side changes.

**Files:**
- Modify: `package.json`, `yarn.lock`

yarn add @astrojs/sitemap@"$VERSION" --exact
```

Expected: `package.json` updated, `yarn.lock` updated, dependency installed.

- [ ] **Step 3: Verify the pin has no caret/tilde**

Run: `grep '@astrojs/sitemap' package.json`

Expected output is a single line of the form `"@astrojs/sitemap": "3.6.0",` (the exact version with no `^` or `~`). If a caret/tilde is present, manually edit `package.json` to remove it and run `yarn install` again.

- [ ] **Step 4: Rewrite `astro.config.mjs`**

Replace the file with this EXACT content (adds the `sitemap` import and the `integrations` array):

```js
import { defineConfig } from 'astro/config';
import sitemap from '@astrojs/sitemap';

export default defineConfig({
  site: 'https://brigitte-le-roux.com',
  i18n: {
    defaultLocale: 'fr',
    locales: ['fr', 'en'],
    routing: { prefixDefaultLocale: false }
  },
  integrations: [
    sitemap({
      i18n: {
        defaultLocale: 'fr',
        locales: { fr: 'fr-FR', en: 'en-US' }
      }
    })
  ],
  server: { port: 4321 },
  build: { format: 'directory' }
});
```

## Task 4: Create the robots.txt endpoint

**Files:**
- Create: `src/pages/robots.txt.js`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the endpoint**

Create `src/pages/robots.txt.js` with this EXACT content:

```js
export const GET = ({ site }) => {
  const sitemap = new URL('/sitemap-index.xml', site).href;
  return new Response(
    `User-agent: *
Allow: /

Sitemap: ${sitemap}
`,
    { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' } }
  );
};
```

```

git commit -m "feat: robots.txt endpoint pointing at sitemap-index.xml"

## Task 5: Rewrite `BaseLayout.astro` with the full SEO meta-tag stack

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro`

This is the largest single change in the plan. The frontmatter script grows from 4 lines to ~25, and the `<head>` adds ~20 tags (meta description, keywords, author, canonical, hreflang × 3, og:* × 7, twitter:* × 4) on top of the existing charset/viewport/title/fonts. The body is unchanged.

- [ ] **Step 1: Replace the entire contents of `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro`**

Write this EXACT content:

```astro
---
import '../styles/theme.css';
import Header from '../components/Header.astro';
import Footer from '../components/Footer.astro';
import frStrings from '../../content/i18n/fr.json';
import enStrings from '../../content/i18n/en.json';

const { title, locale = 'fr', description, keywords } = Astro.props;

const strings = locale === 'en' ? enStrings : frStrings;
const fullTitle = `${title} — Brigitte Le Roux`;
const metaDescription = description || strings.site.description;
const metaKeywords = keywords || strings.site.keywords;
const canonical = new URL(Astro.url.pathname, Astro.site).href;
const ogLocale = locale === 'en' ? 'en_US' : 'fr_FR';
const ogImage = new URL('/img/photoweb.jpg', Astro.site).href;

// Derive the logical slug from the current pathname (strip base, locale prefix, trailing slash).
// Mirrors the logic in src/components/LanguagePicker.astro so hreflang stays in sync.
const baseUrl = import.meta.env.BASE_URL;
const stripped = Astro.url.pathname.startsWith(baseUrl)
  ? Astro.url.pathname.slice(baseUrl.length)
  : Astro.url.pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
const slug = locale === 'fr'
  ? (stripped === '' ? 'home' : stripped.replace(/\/$/, ''))
  : (stripped.replace(/^en\/?/, '').replace(/\/$/, '') || 'home');

// Suppress hreflang for locales whose page doesn't exist (e.g. `bureau` is FR-only).
const allPages = import.meta.glob('../../content/pages/**/*.md', { eager: true });
const frExists = `../../content/pages/${slug}/fr.md` in allPages;
const enExists = `../../content/pages/${slug}/en.md` in allPages;

const frUrl = new URL(slug === 'home' ? '/' : `/${slug}/`, Astro.site).href;
const enUrl = new URL(slug === 'home' ? '/en/' : `/en/${slug}/`, Astro.site).href;
---

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang={locale}>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>{fullTitle}</title>
  <meta name="description" content={metaDescription} />
  <meta name="keywords" content={metaKeywords} />
  <meta name="author" content="Brigitte Le Roux" />
  <link rel="canonical" href={canonical} />

  {frExists && <link rel="alternate" hreflang="fr" href={frUrl} />}
  {enExists && <link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href={enUrl} />}
  {frExists && <link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href={frUrl} />}

  <meta property="og:title" content={fullTitle} />
  <meta property="og:description" content={metaDescription} />
  <meta property="og:url" content={canonical} />
  <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
  <meta property="og:locale" content={ogLocale} />
  <meta property="og:image" content={ogImage} />
  <meta property="og:site_name" content="Brigitte Le Roux" />

  <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
  <meta name="twitter:title" content={fullTitle} />
  <meta name="twitter:description" content={metaDescription} />
  <meta name="twitter:image" content={ogImage} />

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,300;9..144,400;9..144,500;9..144,700&family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,400;12..96,600;12..96,700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
</head>
<body>
  <Header locale={locale} />
  <main class="container">
    <slot />
  </main>
  <Footer locale={locale} />
</body>
</html>
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Build and verify**

Run: `yarn build`

Expected: 23 pages built, no errors.

- [ ] **Step 3: Spot-check FR home page rendered HTML has the new tags**

Run:
```bash
grep -E '(name="description"|name="keywords"|rel="canonical"|hreflang="fr"|hreflang="en"|hreflang="x-default"|og:title|og:image|twitter:card)' dist/index.html | wc -l
```

Expected: a count of at least 9 (one per pattern). If the count is less than 9, one or more tags are missing — investigate before committing.

- [ ] **Step 4: Spot-check `/bureau/` (FR-only) does NOT have hreflang="en"**

Run:
```bash

```

Expected output: `no en hreflang — good` (because `content/pages/bureau/en.md` does not exist, the conditional `enExists` is false).

- [ ] **Step 5: Spot-check EN home has the right `og:locale`**

Run:
```bash
grep 'og:locale' dist/en/index.html
```

Expected: a line containing `content="en_US"`.

- [ ] **Step 6: Commit**

Run:
```bash

git commit -m "feat(BaseLayout): emit full SEO meta-tag stack (description, canonical, hreflang, OG, Twitter)"
```

## Task 7: Add SEO subsection to `CLAUDE.md`

**Files:**
- Modify: `CLAUDE.md`

- [ ] **Step 1: Insert a new section before the "Build & deploy" heading**

Find this line in `CLAUDE.md`:
```
## Build & deploy
```

Insert the following content immediately above it (with a trailing blank line so the spacing matches the surrounding sections):

```markdown
## SEO

Every page renders a full meta-tag stack from `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro`:
description, keywords, author, canonical URL, `hreflang` alternates (FR↔EN
where both versions exist), Open Graph tags, and Twitter card tags. A
generated `robots.txt` (from `src/pages/robots.txt.js`) and a sitemap
(`sitemap-index.xml` + chunks, via `@astrojs/sitemap`) are emitted at build
time and uploaded to S3 by `yarn deploy`.

**Page-level overrides (optional, in markdown frontmatter):**

```yaml
---
title: "Page title"
locale: fr
slug: ...
description: "Specific meta description for this page."
keywords: "narrow, page-specific, keyword, list"
---
```

If `description` or `keywords` is omitted, the locale-wide defaults from
`content/i18n/{fr,en}.json` (`site.description`, `site.keywords`) are used.
Override only when a page benefits from a narrower / more specific snippet —
most pages can rely on the defaults.

`hreflang` alternates are auto-suppressed for pages without a translation
(e.g. `/bureau/` is FR-only and emits only `hreflang="fr"` plus `x-default`).

```

- [ ] **Step 2: Commit**

Run:
```bash

git commit -m "docs(CLAUDE.md): document SEO meta-tag plumbing and frontmatter overrides"
```
